name: Soga Mineo
source:
A part-time teacher at St. Angela Academy and a priest of the morning service.

At first glance, he's friendly and gentle, so he's loved by the students, but his tendencies are that of a shotacon. Devil's first mono-eating specialty.

Hobby: Gardening (he has a rose garden)

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160802161324/http://www.hanerom.dojin.com/p_mineo.html]official website[/url]]
